message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes. Facts: Xiong (邢某) was accountant, cash custodian. He misappropriated 300,000 yuan of land compensation funds he was supposed to keep and disburse to farmers. He borrowed with Jiang (江某甲). This is embezzlement (挪用公款) maybe "挪用公款罪" (misappropriation of public funds). Also could be fraud? The rule says when facts describe defendant’s role in scheme that withdraws money from victims’ bank or credit‑card accounts, classify under fraud. Here it's misappropriation of public funds, not victim bank accounts. So likely crime: 挪用公款 (misappropriation of public funds). Also maybe "受贿"? No, he didn't receive bribe. He just misused funds. So single charge: 挪用公款. According to instruction: list only statutory offense name without appending “罪”. So just "挪用公款". Output format: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa>. JSON with final_answer containing that string?
